accessibility.evidence: Native dialog labelled by heading. Shift+Tab wrapped from Close to Save with visible solid focus; Escape closed and restored focus to the originating Edit button. Labelled fields, focused inline LinkedIn validation error, light/dark visual review, 40px controls. Reduced-motion CSS disables card movement and skeleton animation; OS preference emulation was not available.

responsive.evidence: Rendered at exact 1440x900 and 390x844 using device emulation. document scrollWidth equals viewport width. Mobile form scrollWidth/clientWidth both 390; footer bottom remains 844. Mobile fields use 16px type; desktop uses a two-column panel.

loading.evidence: Skeleton collections and disabled Saving controls implemented. Live async collection loading cannot be exercised before the deferred Supabase connection.

permission.evidence: Admin verification remains enforced for configured Supabase. No project exists yet; live authentication and denied-access rendering are not tested in this layout-preview phase.
